column1: # p345 — the region table this base owes a reader, split into the TWO questions it has been
# merging: is there SUPPLY (a placeable, licensed repository) and is there RETRIEVABLE POLICY?

column4: The region this base called barren for six consecutive passes is the one that produced the single largest NEW row of this pass.  The gap was in the QUERY, not the supply — and the row was sitting in this base's own orphan list.

column2: 🟢 YES — terracotta-education/terracotta, Apache-2.0, 2815 commits, 18 authors, live to 2026-10-19, unicon.net + iu.edu + calpoly.edu
column3: 🟢 YES, and it is the richest policy channel of the four — but it is STATE-level and fragmented
column4: No federal binding AI curriculum standard reported as of 2026-05.  ~34 states + DC + PR have issued guidance.  Named statutes: Idaho SB 1227 (signed 2026-03-19, effective 2026-07-01), Ohio (district AI policy due 2026-07-01), Oklahoma SB 1734 (policy before the 2027-28 school year), Maryland SB 720 (status uncertain across trackers).  SUNY: AI literacy in general education for incoming undergraduates from Fall 2026.  🔴 One source reports Colorado repealed its AI Act in 2026-05 — SINGLE SOURCE, not adopted.

column2: 🟡 PARTIAL — AI-for-Education/pedagogy-benchmark placed to glasgow.ac.uk (5/5 commits), MIT, but a 5-commit bench.  EscolaLMS/LRS places to Poland and is dead since 2024-07
column3: 🟢 YES — the strongest POLICY channel this pass: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 defers Annex III education high-risk to 2027-12-02 while Article 50 transparency and the 2025-02-02 emotion-recognition prohibition stay live
column4: 🔴 PRIMARY SOURCE UNREACHABLE: every EU domain returns HTTP 000 from this environment, so the dates are a secondary convergence and are published as such.

column2: 🔴 NO AUTHORSHIP-PLACED ROW.  But this pass refutes the bare form of that absence: AI-for-Education (a Glasgow-benched org) runs an Africa-TARGETING portfolio — luganda-linguistic-benchmarks (Uganda), lesson-plan-parse-mbsse (Sierra Leone Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education), gpf-alignment and global-proficiency-framework
column4: 🔴 AND THE TARGETING ROWS ARE MOSTLY UNBUILDABLE: gpf-alignment and luganda-linguistic-benchmarks return HTTP 404 on LICENSE — NO GRANT.  Only lesson-plan-parse-mbsse (MIT, 1065 B) and edu-qurating (MIT, 1063 B) carry one, at 1 and 3 stars.  So: the work exists, the grants largely do not, and the authorship is European.  That is three different findings and merging them is what produced six passes of "nothing on Africa".

column3: 🔴 THIN — the prescribed APAC policy leg returned nothing on Chinese, Indian or Singaporean school-AI rules.  Japan: movement toward official digital textbooks (one roundup, no AI-specific rule)
column4: The exact inverse of MEA.  One citable regional datum: Digital Education Council Global Survey 2026 reports APAC faculty the MOST enthusiastic (57% excited) while faculty INTENT to use AI fell 76% (2025) to 67% (2026) — the lowest adoption intent of any region.  Enthusiasm and intent are moving in opposite directions.
